A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the net canopy exchange of atmospheric S is not a simple linear function of atmospheric S deposition.
the canopy is a major sink of sulphur in the boreal forest.
, in the boreal region, S deposition is not only a function of atmospheric S concentration but also of canopy characteristics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the S budget of a forest is not necessarily a simple function of wet deposition.
the net canopy exchange of S is a valuable tool to estimate dry deposition in forest canopies, even in areas of low S atmospheric deposition.
the net canopy exchange approach should be used with care, as it can lead to erroneous conclusions about the importance of S deposition in forest ecosystems.
